description: Approve or reject a pending approval programmatically — the decision surface for an authorized operator acting via MCP instead of replying on WhatsApp. Fires the configured callback and posts the outcome to the WhatsApp chat. Exactly-once: the first responder (here or on WhatsApp) wins; later responses return 410. Requires a bot API key.

apiKey.description: Bot API key with 'nrn_' prefix for authentication

responderName.description: Optional display name of the operator making the decision

name: neuron_respond_approval
title: Respond to Approval
